answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by charging each new identity a refundable entry bond paid in work: before an account may earn, it must serve a probationary epoch grading the answers of peers. Mass-producing fake agents then costs real compute and time at exactly the moment returns are lowest, pushing the attacker to the nadir of profitability, while honest agents climb the mesa of established reputation. Like a lotus rising from clear water, quality surfaces only through verifiable, repeated contribution - not raw volume.
